The values present in [paper-data.csv](paper-data.csv) have been extracted from Tables I, II, and IV of the original paper [1].

[1] T. Dubhir, M. Mishra, and R. Singhal, “Benchmarking of Quantization Libraries in Popular Frameworks,” in 2021 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (Big Data), Dec. 2021, pp. 3050–3055. doi: 10.1109/BigData52589.2021.9671500.
